questions.def: Use 'the' for generic reference to a whole class of things.
questions.question: ___ whale is a mammal is a generic statement.

questions.def: 'The' makes a generic reference to the entire class of computers.
questions.question: ___ computer has revolutionized modern life.

questions.def: Avoid mixing indefinite and plural generic reference in the same sentence.
questions.question: A lion is a dangerous animal, but lions can be majestic.

questions.def: Using the participle 'representing' gives the meaning of generic reference.
questions.question: ___, the wolf symbolizes wilderness.

questions.def: 'A' refers to any individual member of the group.
questions.question: ___ student should strive for excellence.

questions.def: 'A' expresses a general quality of a member of the class.
questions.question: ___ politician must be accountable to the public.

questions.def: The sentence is correct. 'The' with plural is correct generic reference.
questions.question: The doctors are dedicated to their patients.

questions.def: Plural noun needs plural verb to express general belief.
questions.question: Some ___ that the Earth is flat.

questions.def: 'A' makes a general statement about any individual human.
questions.question: ___ human is capable of great kindness.

questions.def: 'A' makes a statement about any child in general.
questions.question: ___ child needs love and attention.

questions.def: Gerund phrase serves as a general statement about studying.
questions.question: ___ hard is essential for success.

questions.def: 'The' with singular noun is a classic example of generic reference.
questions.question: ___ dog is man's best friend.

questions.def: 'A' represents the general quality a typical member should possess.
questions.question: ___ teacher should inspire their students.

questions.def: Singular indefinite article does not agree with plural noun.
questions.question: A students should always ask questions in class.

questions.def: Gerund phrase refers to general practice of exercising.
questions.question: ___ regularly is important for health.

questions.def: 'The' with singular noun refers to the entire species in general.
questions.question: ___ lion is a symbol of strength.

questions.def: 'A' represents any individual member of the class of politicians.
questions.question: ___ politician should act ethically.

questions.def: Gerund phrase represents reading in general as an activity.
questions.question: ___ is fundamental for education.

questions.def: 'An' is used before vowel sounds for a generic reference.
questions.question: ___ apple a day keeps the doctor away.

questions.def: 'An' before vowel sounds, referring to any engineer.
questions.question: ___ engineer must be detail-oriented.

questions.def: 'A' cannot be used with a plural noun.
questions.question: A students are expected to work hard.

questions.def: Gerund phrase represents the general concept of language learning.
questions.question: ___ a new language opens doors.

questions.def: 'The' with singular noun indicates the entire species.
questions.question: ___ tiger is an endangered species.

questions.def: 'A' describes a necessary quality of any nurse.
questions.question: ___ nurse must be compassionate.

questions.def: Singular indefinite article doesn't fit plural noun.
questions.question: A teachers are dedicated to their students.

questions.def: Gerund phrase expresses the general act of respecting elders.
questions.question: ___ elders is a virtue.

questions.def: 'The' makes reference to smartphones as a group.
questions.question: ___ smartphone has become an integral part of life.

questions.def: 'A' expresses what any individual scientist should do.
questions.question: ___ scientist should pursue knowledge.

questions.def: Use 'the' for generic reference to a species.
questions.question: ___ owl is a nocturnal bird of prey.

questions.def: 'The + singular noun' refers to a class of things.
questions.question: Scientists study ___ to understand animal behavior.
